permissions.readTeamFilesDesc: When off, the ResourceFetch tool is neither offered to the agent nor honored if called.
permissions.autoBroadcastDesc: Allow the agent to post automatic updates (e.g. task completion) to its groups.
permissions.scopeIntro: Where this agent may act and what it may see. All off by default.
permissions.capabilitiesIntro: High-risk abilities, denied by default. Each one lets the agent change your work, read beyond the current episode, or spend money — grant only what this agent needs.
permissions.writeLevelDesc: How far the agent may go when it wants to change a script. Tools outside the granted tier are hidden from the agent AND blocked at dispatch — hiding alone is never the guard.
permissions.writeLevelHint_none: The agent cannot open scenes at all. Even read-only tools stay denied.
permissions.writeLevelHint_read: The agent may read scenes, but cannot suggest or make changes.
permissions.writeLevelHint_propose: The agent drafts changes for you to accept. Nothing is saved without your approval.
permissions.writeLevelHint_write: The agent saves changes directly to your scripts.
permissions.generateImageDesc: Allow the agent to create images. Image generation is billed to your project quota.
permissions.generateVideoDesc: Allow the agent to create video. Far more expensive than images — grant sparingly.
permissions.mediaCapDesc: Ceiling on how many images or videos the agent may produce in a single turn. Enforced per call at dispatch.
permissions.mediaCapDisabledHint: Enable image or video generation first — the ceiling has no effect until one is granted.
permissions.crossEpisodeReadDesc: Allow reading episodes beyond the one this run was given, for continuity. Scope can widen to the project, never beyond it.
permissions.changeLogIntro: Recent permission changes to this agent. Records are append-only.

save_the_cat.name: Save the Cat!
save_the_cat.desc: Blake Snyder's 15-beat structure for a feature-length story.

opening_image.name: Opening Image
opening_image.guide: A snapshot of the hero's world and tone, before the story changes everything.

theme_stated.name: Theme Stated
theme_stated.guide: Someone states what the story is really about — the lesson the hero must learn.

setup.name: Setup
setup.guide: Introduce the hero, their world, and what is missing from their life.

catalyst.name: Catalyst
catalyst.guide: An event breaks the hero's ordinary life and sets the story in motion.

debate.name: Debate
debate.guide: The hero hesitates — should they answer the call, and what is at stake?

break_into_two.name: Break into Two
break_into_two.guide: The hero makes a choice and steps into the new world of Act Two.

b_story.name: B Story
b_story.guide: A secondary story — often love or friendship — that carries the theme.

fun_and_games.name: Fun and Games
fun_and_games.guide: The promise of the premise: the set pieces the audience came to see.

midpoint.name: Midpoint
midpoint.guide: A false victory or false defeat raises the stakes and turns the story.

bad_guys_close_in.name: Bad Guys Close In
bad_guys_close_in.guide: Internal and external pressures tighten around the hero.

all_is_lost.name: All Is Lost
all_is_lost.guide: The lowest point — the hero loses what matters most.

dark_night_of_the_soul.name: Dark Night of the Soul
dark_night_of_the_soul.guide: The hero wallows in defeat before finding a new resolve.

break_into_three.name: Break into Three
break_into_three.guide: A revelation, often from the B story, shows the hero the way forward.

finale.name: Finale
finale.guide: The hero applies the lesson and confronts the antagonist one last time.

final_image.name: Final Image
final_image.guide: The mirror of the opening image, showing how far the hero has changed.

five_beats.name: Five Beats
five_beats.desc: The compact dramatic spine — five turning points from inciting incident to resolution.

inciting_incident.name: Inciting Incident
inciting_incident.guide: The event that upsets the balance and launches the story.

progressive_complications.name: Progressive Complications
progressive_complications.guide: Rising obstacles force ever-harder choices on the protagonist.

crisis.name: Crisis
crisis.guide: The protagonist faces a dilemma with no easy way out.

climax.name: Climax
climax.guide: The decisive confrontation — the story's peak of tension.

resolution.name: Resolution
resolution.guide: The new balance settles; consequences and change are shown.

kishotenketsu.name: Kishotenketsu
kishotenketsu.desc: A four-act structure built on development and a twist rather than conflict.

ki.name: Ki — Introduction
ki.guide: Introduce the characters, the setting, and the situation.

sho.name: Sho — Development
sho.guide: Develop the situation, deepening it without a major change.

ten.name: Ten — Twist
ten.guide: An unexpected turn recontextualizes everything that came before.

ketsu.name: Ketsu — Conclusion
ketsu.guide: Reconcile the twist with the whole and bring the story to a close.
